build_cmds: make -j"$(nproc)" TARGET=linux-glibc USE_OPENSSL=1 USE_QUIC=1 USE_QUIC_OPENSSL_COMPAT=1 USE_LUA=1 USE_PCRE2=1 USE_PCRE2_JIT=1 USE_PROMEX=1
source._build_note: Plain GNU make, no configure. The Makefile auto-detects Lua 5.4 under /usr/include/lua5.4 and the library name lua5.4 (Makefile check_lua_inc/check_lua_lib); libcrypt (USE_LIBCRYPT, a linux-glibc default) comes from libcrypt-dev, which build-essential's libc6-dev pulls in on the ubuntu:24.04 builder (libcrypt1 is in the runtime base). In-tree code only: SLZ compression, ebtree, xxhash, mjson (MIT), the Prometheus exporter addon -- no dependency download. `make install-bin PREFIX=/opt/haproxy` installs exactly /opt/haproxy/sbin/haproxy (install-bin is in the Makefile's IGNORE_OPTS, so it does not re-evaluate the USE_* options; checked locally). install-admin (haproxy-reload / haproxy-dump-certs shell scripts that need socat), install-man and install-doc are deliberately skipped. NEVER run `make reg-tests` (needs VTest, fetched separately).
